revision_basis.v0_7_process_error: double free or corruption (out); exit code 134
revision_basis.diagnosis_scope: Native-process abort occurred after the frozen geometry artifacts were downloaded and before any phase-1 report was persisted. Revision 0.8 changes execution isolation only: each target is computed in a fresh Python process using the unchanged revision-0.7 target metric, exact DEM, routing replay and scientific guard functions. No metric formula, geometry, outlet, routing semantic, DEM reconstruction rule, threshold or target selection is changed.

execution_isolation.reason_parallel_workers_disabled: Avoid concurrent writes to the shared exact-source-tile cache and keep failure attribution deterministic; this is an execution-integrity choice, not a scientific selection rule.

forbidden: read A6680 numeric morphometry before phase-1 output is frozen by hash
read sealed outcomes before the allowed unblind
use any metric value from a worker to select, tune, drop or rerun a target under different scientific semantics
move an outlet or alter/expand a frozen basin polygon
change DEM conditioning, slope algorithm, channel threshold or metric inclusion rule
accept a regenerated DEM whose binary GeoTIFF SHA256 differs from the frozen geometry-generation DEM hash
treat a worker crash, missing artifact or native-process failure as zero, dry, inactive or scientifically usable
